boundary: Native QComboBox/Z_ComboBox and QFontComboBox/Z_FontComboBox are not semantic Z_Select aliases. Size/state affect presentation only, retaining model, view, delegate, native editor, validator, completer, insertion, keyboard, signals and font filters/writing systems. Combo placeholderText is painted only at non-editable currentIndex=-1, never an item/currentText. Gallery FontComboBox uses a non-editable closed specimen and source-only Arial label independent of installed font fallback; live stays native editable. Focus does not open the popup. Prefix/Clear/arbitrary suffix are Figma visual adapter proposals, not native API; captured hidden assets are retained but no unapproved behavior invented. Disabled fill is black alpha .04 and content alpha .7; no dark/profile parity, normalization or design approval promotion.
